usage: wordfreq.py [-h] [--top TOP] [-i] [file]

Print the most frequent words of a text file (or stdin).

positional arguments:
  file               text file; reads stdin when omitted

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --top TOP          how many words to print (default 10)
  -i, --ignore-case  count 'The' and 'the' as one word

cmd:
python3 -c '
import subprocess
out = subprocess.check_output("echo \"apple banana apple orange banana apple\" | python3 wordfreq.py --top 2", shell=True, text=True)
expected = "    3 apple\n    2 banana\n"
assert out == expected, f"Expected {repr(expected)}, got {repr(out)}"
print("Stdin example verified exactly.")
'
